title: Twilio restricted API key fails with error 8021 although Read is granted
symptoms: Listing messages fails with a key that has Read
cause: Restricted keys separate List from Read. Listing resources needs the List permission.
fix: Tick List as well as Read for each resource the key must enumerate.
apply: https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/keys-credentials/api-keys/<key SID>: tick List next to Read for Messages, then Save
